title: Embedding router circuit breaker settings are not refreshed on config update
reasoning: The embedding_router is initially constructed with provider_circuit_breaker_failure_threshold and provider_circuit_breaker_cooldown_seconds from config. On later config updates, OCR and vision routers explicitly call configure_circuit_breaker before swapping providers, but the embedder path only recreates the provider and calls set_provider. If the user changes the provider circuit breaker settings, OCR and vision honor the new values while embedding keeps the old thresholds/cooldown.
recommendation: Mirror the OCR/vision update behavior in _reinitialize_embedder by calling embedding_router.configure_circuit_breaker with the updated config before or after set_provider, guarded with hasattr if needed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests are limited to incoming_routing and do not exercise provider routers or config update behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a focused config updater test with a fake embedding_router that records configure_circuit_breaker and set_provider calls, then verify update_config applies the new threshold and cooldown for memory-enabled configs.
